messages:
maria: opened PR #4527 — tweaks to Troubleshooting / Error Reference for context-trim fallback behavior. goal: clearer decision table + two SDK snippets (sync/async) showing graceful retry with context trimming, and an example curl repro for streaming interruption cases. PTAL :eyes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4527
aj: taking a look now. does the snippet use the new retry header behavior (x-rw-retry) we landed last sprint? want to make sure we don't show users the old retry loop.
ben: quick flag — the doc currently says we "preserve full original prompt in logs" which isn't correct when trim happens on the request path. can we reword to "we log the trimmed prompt and retain a hash of the original for debugging"?
sam: i can add a tiny integration test to reproduce the stream interruption -> fallback, will attach curl + server logs. ping me if you want the exact payload shape.
nina: for Dedicated customers, can we add a short note under "rollback" and "canary"? they need explicit instructions for pinning to legacy variants if they rely on older context behavior.
maria: good catches — updated PR to change the logging wording and added a short dedicated-customer paragraph. also included a minimal curl repro and this inline snippet (sync + async):

```python
# sync: attempt + fallback with context trim
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
try:
    resp = client.generate(model="xlarge", prompt=long_prompt, max_tokens=512)
except Redwood429Error:
    # trim context and retry once
    trimmed = trim_prefix(long_prompt, keep_last_k=1024)
    resp = client.generate(model="xlarge-trimmed", prompt=trimmed, headers={"x-rw-retry": "1"})
```

```python
# async example
async with RedwoodClient() as c:
    stream = await c.stream_chat(model="xlarge", messages=messages)
    async for chunk in stream:
        process(chunk)
    # if stream abruptly closes with code=429, run the same context-trim fallback
```

aj: looks fine but two nits: 1) use `with_retry(header=True)` helper instead of manually setting header (we want examples using public SDK helpers); 2) show the header in curl too.
ben: also add wording for variant fallback — when we fall back to `-trimmed` there's a potential quality delta, add a one-sentence recommendation to run a short regression eval on the trimmed variant before enabling auto-fallback.
sam: here's the curl I tested (works locally) — include in PR under "repro":

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge","prompt":"<very long prompt>","max_tokens":512,"stream":true}' \
  # if connection closes and server returns 429, retry with trimmed prompt and header x-rw-retry:1
```

maria: perfect — i'll switch snippet to `with_retry` helper and add ben's regression note. sam, please drop the exact curl text into the repro section.
